title: [ffmpeg:arm64-linux] build failure

labels.name: category:port-bug
labels.description: The issue is with a library, which is something the port should already support

body:
**Host Environment**
- OS: Linux
- Compiler: GCC 9.3.0

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
```
./vcpkg install ffmpeg
find installed/ -name "*.lib"

# Output:
installed/arm64-linux/lib/avdevice.lib
installed/arm64-linux/lib/avcodec.lib
installed/arm64-linux/lib/swresample.lib
installed/arm64-linux/lib/swscale.lib
installed/arm64-linux/lib/avfilter.lib
installed/arm64-linux/lib/avresample.lib
installed/arm64-linux/lib/avutil.lib
installed/arm64-linux/lib/avformat.lib
installed/arm64-linux/debug/lib/avdevice.lib
installed/arm64-linux/debug/lib/avcodec.lib
installed/arm64-linux/debug/lib/swresample.lib
installed/arm64-linux/debug/lib/swscale.lib
installed/arm64-linux/debug/lib/avfilter.lib
installed/arm64-linux/debug/lib/avresample.lib
installed/arm64-linux/debug/lib/avutil.lib
installed/arm64-linux/debug/lib/avformat.lib
```

**Failure logs** 
*The build completes successfully, but the output libraries have the wrong extension (`avutil.lib` should be `libavutil.a`) and FindFFMPEG fails*

*(Notice how it says --target-os=win32 in Build Options)*
